<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def green_pos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rs),min(cs))
def train_rows(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','r') and n['pixels']>=16:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return out
print("before:", green_pos(current_frame), train_rows(current_frame))

print("UP diff:", diff)
print("after:", green_pos(current_frame), train_rows(current_frame))
</parameter>

def green_pos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rs),min(cs))
def train_rows(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','r') and n['pixels']>=16:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return out
